title: Does coverage explain core-set active learning? Mean, max, and the choice of distance
abstract: arXiv:2611.30450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Core-set selection casts batch active learning as a covering problem, in which the points to label minimise the covering radius of the pool. Its main argument is a generalization bound in which this radius controls the gap between the loss on the pool and on the labelled sample. We examine what this bound requires and what it says in practice. We first state it with the assumption that its proof uses at the labelled points, a zero conditional risk, and show that it then holds for any dissimilarity and any selection rule that uses no label outside the sample. The proof works point by point and involves two averages, the mean distance of the pool to the labelled sample and the purity of the cells attached to the labelled points. Keeping them gives, when labels are deterministic at the labelled points, a bound on the pool loss with no zero-loss assumption and without the factor C, the number of classes, of the original constant. translated_title: 覆盖能否解释核心集主动学习？均值、最大值与距离的选择
translated_abstract: 核心集选择将批量主动学习视为一个覆盖问题，即待标注的点使数据池的覆盖半径最小化。其核心论据是一个泛化界，其中该半径控制着数据池损失与已标注样本损失之间的差距。我们考察了这一界所要求的前提条件及其在实践中的含义。我们首先在证明所用的标注点处零条件风险假设下陈述该界，并证明此时它对任意不相似度度量以及任何不使用样本外标签的选择规则均成立。该证明逐点进行，并涉及两个平均值：数据池到已标注样本的平均距离，以及与标注点相关联的单元的纯度。在标注点标签确定的情况下，保留这两个量便可得到数据池损失的界，无需零损失假设，并且去掉了原常数中类别数 C 这一因子。
tldr: 本文证明核心集主动学习的覆盖泛化界对任意不相似度度量和任何不使用样本外标签的选择规则均成立，且在标注点标签确定时无需零损失假设、去除了类别数因子 C，仅依赖池到标注样本的平均距离与单元纯度。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the core-set active learning covering generalization bound holds for any dissimilarity and any selection rule using no labels outside the sample, and when labels are deterministic at the labelled points it yields a pool-loss bound without the zero-loss assumption or the class-count factor C, depending only on the pool's mean distance to the labelled sample and cell purity.
